title.narrative: Support to the national HIV/AIDS response in Jamaica - Jamaica (01-Jan-2016-31-Dec-2018)

description.narrative: Jamaica, HIV, Ministry of Health and Wellness, Jamaica (MOHW)This program has the following goals: Reduce AIDS related morbidity and mortality with effective Biomedical and supporting interventions. Reduce new HIV infections among key populations through behavioral and structural interventions. The objectives of this program are: Improve access to HIV treatment and care services through the protection and promotion of Human Rights for key populations. Improve strategic information to guide programme development, implementation and evaluation. Increase access to a comprehensive package of prevention services to reduce new HIV/STI infections among key populations.. Increase capacity of PLHIV, CSOs and key populations to engage in partnerships, advocacy and monitoring of service provision and delivery. Provide comprehensive package of care to improve linkage, retention and adherance. Scale up HIV testing targeting key populations to identify new cases and provide timely linkage to treatment and care
